# agent-evidence-vectors

> A recomputable execution attestation toolkit: a reference verifier and
> conformance vector corpora for the in-toto Adversarial Execution Evidence
> predicate (version 0.7, tracked at in-toto/attestation#570) and the AI Agent
> Action predicate (version 0.1, proposed at in-toto/attestation#588), with
> further corpora for carriage over SCITT and COSE receipts, artifact binding,
> the agent capability interface, the agent control standard, anchor-stream
> verification, and cross-implementation run records.

The model is execute-and-attest, not match-and-assert: a consumer recomputes
the outcome from carried bytes instead of trusting a producer-asserted verdict.
Each corpus directory carries a `MANIFEST.json` naming its suite and its
`corpusDigest`, and each member declares the verdict and the codes a conforming
verifier must produce. A verifier that answers with an exit status alone fails
every vector, and each corpus pairs its reject members with accepting twins so
that one refusing everything scores zero rather than full marks. Every count published in the
repository is derived from a manifest by a gate, never typed, and this file
carries none for the same reason: read them from the manifests or from the
signed `release/CORPUS-DIGESTS.txt`.

## Entry points

- [PyPI package](https://pypi.org/project/agent-evidence-vectors/): `agent-evidence-vectors`, stdlib-only, carrying the harness as the console script of the same name and every corpus as package data; `uvx agent-evidence-vectors --verifier '<cmd>'` replays the AEE corpus against a verifier with nothing cloned, `--corpus <name>` selects another, `--list-corpora` prints the names and `--self-test` runs the reference rail against its own oracle.
- [GitHub Action](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/main/action.yml): `uses: probityai/agent-evidence-vectors@v0.12.0` with a `verifier` input replays the corpus in a consumer's CI, writes a job summary, uploads the report as the artifact `agent-evidence-vectors-results`, and fails the job when any vector disagreed.
- [README](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/main/README.md): The predicates, the corpora, the external verifier contract the harness speaks, the failure-code registry, and how to verify a release without trusting the maintainer.
- [Distribution](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/main/DISTRIBUTION.md): The tag to cite, the one-command run, the corpus table, how to cite a run, and how to add a corpus.
- [Independent runs](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/main/RUNS.md): Every run of a corpus by an implementation this repository did not write, in its author's words, labelled blind or directed as the author labelled it.
- [Reference verifier](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/tree/main/cmd/aee-verify): The Go command-line verifier; install with `go install github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/cmd/aee-verify@<tag>`. The core package is `aee/`, standard library only.
- [Harness](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/main/packaging/run_vectors.py): Drives any verifier over a corpus as `<cmd> <vector-file>` and compares codes and recomputed results against the manifest.
- [Failure codes](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/main/aee/codes.go): The closed code set, compared as a set by the harness; message text carries nothing.
- [Vendored specification](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/main/spec/predicates/adversarial-execution-evidence.md): The predicate text the suite implements, pinned by `spec/VENDOR-PIN.json`.
- [Governance](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md), [Contributing](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md), [Dispositions](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/main/DISPOSITIONS.md): Who decides, what a proposal goes through, and every outside objection with its resolution.

## Corpora

One directory each, each with its own `MANIFEST.json`, `corpusDigest` and generator.

- [vectors/](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/tree/main/vectors): `adversarial-execution-evidence-conformance`, the AEE predicate; the per-revision ledger is `vectors/CHANGES.md`.
- [vectors-ai-agent-action/](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/tree/main/vectors-ai-agent-action): `ai-agent-action-conformance`, the AI Agent Action predicate plus the canonicalization text this repository proposes for it.
- [vectors-ai-generation/](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/tree/main/vectors-ai-generation): `ai-generation-v01-conformance`, the generation predicate for AI-authored code at specification revision 0.1.3, attest-only verification, plus proposed text for what the revision leaves open.
- [vectors-scitt-cose/](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/tree/main/vectors-scitt-cose): `scitt-cose-carriage-conformance`, carriage of the AEE predicate as a SCITT Transparent Statement under `profiles/scitt-cose.md`.
- [vectors-artifact-binding/](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/tree/main/vectors-artifact-binding): `artifact-binding-conformance`, the contract in `spec/artifact-binding/v1.md`, over three verdicts.
- [vectors-aci/](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/tree/main/vectors-aci): `aci`, the agent capability interface levels and their serialization.
- [vectors-acs-core/](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/tree/main/vectors-acs-core): `acs-core-negative-conformance`, the mandatory profile of the agent control standard, by negative members against vendored text.
- [vectors-anchor-stream/](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/tree/main/vectors-anchor-stream): `anchor-stream-conformance`, the anchor-stream verification contract published by aos-standard/catalog.
- [vectors-mcp-record-contract/](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/tree/main/vectors-mcp-record-contract): `cross-run-record-contract`, what a cross-implementation run record has to carry.
- [vectors-mcp-response-phase/](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/tree/main/vectors-mcp-response-phase): `mcp-response-phase-interception`, whether a response-phase MCP interceptor is invoked on JSON-RPC error frames.
- [vectors-observed-effect/](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/tree/main/vectors-observed-effect): `observed-effect-conformance`, the Observed Effect predicate defined in `spec/predicates/observed-effect.md`, whose type URI is `https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-vectors/predicate/v1/observed-effect`.
- [vectors-w3c-report/](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/tree/main/vectors-w3c-report): `w3c-report-v01-conformance`, the v0.1 per-check report of the W3C public-agent-conformance group as whole reports, with the emitter that writes one from the AEE harness report.

## Identifiers

- Release tag: `v0.12.0`, as `CITATION.cff` and `DISTRIBUTION.md` carry it; a git tag with a GitHub Release per tag, and a PyPI release of the same version cut from that tag.
- Go module: `github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors`.
- Signed corpus digests: [release/CORPUS-DIGESTS.txt](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/main/release/CORPUS-DIGESTS.txt), one line per corpus, with a detached signature, an RFC 3161 token and an OpenTimestamps proof beside it.
- Archival DOI: concept DOI [10.5281/zenodo.22758687](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22758687), which resolves to the newest archived release; each release also has its own version DOI, listed on that record. `CITATION.cff` carries the concept DOI so a citation stays stable across releases.
- [Citation](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/main/CITATION.cff): Cite the repository, the suiteRevision or tag you ran, and the corpusDigest of the corpus you ran.

## Consumers

- [probityai/agent-evidence-admission](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-admission): Reference admission rails on four policy engines, measured against this corpus at a pinned tag.
- [probityai/agent-evidence-vocabulary](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vocabulary): The closed vocabulary for the claim terms the predicate carries.
